# Vendored dependencies

These dependencies are checked into the customer package so the default Windows and
Ubuntu builds do not require vcpkg, apt development packages, Git, or network access.

- `libzmq/`: libzmq 4.3.5 source and its upstream license files.
- `cppzmq/`: cppzmq 4.11.0 headers and `LICENSE`.
- `nlohmann_json/`: JSON for Modern C++ 3.12.0 single header and `LICENSE.MIT`.

Version and license links are summarized in `../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
